questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

 Statements:

 A. Some dogs are frogs.

 B. Some swans are dogs.

 Conclusions:

 I. Some frogs are swans.

 II. No dogs are swans.
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

 A. Some dogs are frogs.

 B. Some swans are dogs.

The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ef4a9c3171556e32732a6041391bc666f0b78f8f429fec18f4d38df56f47db8.png] 

** Conclusions:**

 I. Some frogs are swans - False(because, there is no direct relation is given between them, so it can be possible only).

 II. No dogs are swans - False(because, Some swans are dogs is given so it can not be possible)

Thus, None of the conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:

(16, 6, 81)

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. questions.solution:

Logic: **3rd number = (1st number × 2nd number) - 15.**

For, (10, 8, 65)
